# BlackLands (depthofdejenol)

> **Overview**  
> BlackLands is a party‑based dungeon‑crawler / RPG written in C++20 with Qt 6. It offers deep character creation and progression, skill acquisition, party management, spell casting, item identification, crafting, dungeon exploration, combat, and a full city‑economy loop. The code is data‑driven (JSON/CSV/Lua), includes a headless test suite, and ships with a small collection of editor utilities.

## Project Overview

* **Project name:** BlackLands (repository: `depthofdejenol`)
* **Language:** C++20, Qt 6 (Core, GUI, Widgets, Multimedia, Network)
* **Engine:** Qt/QML offscreen; legacy XCB rendering
* **Platform:** Linux, Windows, macOS (Linux development builds use X11/XCB)
* **Data format:** JSON, CSV, Lua scripts, binary loader
* **Dependencies:** Qt6 (core + gui + widgets + multimedia + network), Lua 5.5 (stand‑alone), various data files (JSON, CSV, binaries)

The game revolves around recruiting a party of up to four characters, descending into the Depths (a multi‑level dungeon), fighting monsters, looting items, restoring party members, learning spells and skills, and returning to the surface to level up, identify items, buy and sell equipment, and progress through a quest chain.  High‑level features include:

* Party management and character creation / editing
* Deep skill acquisition & allocation (v6.1.0 slice 6.1a)
* Combat with turn‑based engine, monster AI, and victory rewards
* Spell casting with school proficiency and slots
* Item identification, crafting, and thorough inventory management
* Guilds, companions, marriage, aging, and NPC interaction
* Multiplayer city/market (TCP chat, shared gold)
* Auto‑save, autosave, hall of records, and achievements

## Repository Structure

```
depthofdejenol/
├── blacklands.pro                 # qmake project file
├── version.h.in                   # version header template
├── version.h                      # generated version header
├── README.md                      # high‑level overview
├── docs/
│   ├── ROADMAP_v4.0.0.md          # current roadmap
│   ├── ROADMAP_v6.1.0.md          # v6.1.0 roadmap (skill system etc.)
│   ├── archive/                   # older roadmaps
│   └── (release notes etc.)
├── data/                          # game data (JSON, CSV, Lua, saves)
│   ├── levels.json
│   ├── guilds.json
│   ├── spells.json
│   ├── races.json
│   ├── bestiary.json
│   ├── characters/*.json
│   ├── saves/*.json
│   ├── scripts/*.lua
│   └── (binary loader data: MDATA*, .MDR, .hex etc.)
├── resources/                     # images, sounds, fonts, midi
├── src/                           # C++ source code (see below)
├── src/skill/                     # NEW: v6.1.0 skill system
├── test/                          # headless test harness
├── tools/                         # data conversion & editor utilities
├── build/                         # generated by qmake (not part of repo)
├── 3rdparty/                      # bundled Lua 5.5 source (vendor)
└── .github/                       # CI & agent configuration
```

The **src/** directory is split into functional subdirectories:

| Sub‑dir                     | Purpose (key files) |
|----------------------------|---------------------|
| `core`                     | Game state, constants, level table, quests, aging, endgame, etc. |
| `character_dialog`         | `CharacterDialog`, `CharacterSheetDialog`, `CreateCharacterDialog` etc. |
| `combat`                   | `CombatState`, `TurnEngine`, `MonsterAI`, `CombatActions`, etc. |
| `spell_casting`            | `SpellBook`, `SpellMechanics`, `SpellCastingDialog` |
| `items`                    | `ItemDatabase`, `ItemProgression` |
| `partymanager`             | `PartyManager` |
| `game_controller`          | `GameController` (main loop) |
| `network_manager`          | `NetworkManager` (multiplayer) |
| `update`                   | `UpdateManager`, `UpdateDialog` (auto‑update) |
| `event`                    | `EventManager` |
| `character_dialog`         | UI for character sheet, creation, etc. |
| (many more)                | UI dialogs for shops, guilds, inventory, etc. |

## Core Source Files & Class Definitions

### Entry Points

| File / Symbol | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| `blacklands.cpp::main(int argc, char *argv[])` | Application entry. Creates a `QApplication`, then either runs the headless test suite (`--selftest`, `--probe‑dungeon`) or the normal GUI. |
| `gameStateManager::instance()` | Thread‑local singleton (C‑style `extern "C"` includes Lua). |
| `test/selftest.cpp::runSelfTest()` | Headless test runner; returns `0` on success, non‑zero on failure. |
| `test/equipment_test.cpp::runEquipmentTest()` | Additional equipment‑focused tests run after the main self‑test. |

### Game State & Architecture

| File / Symbol | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| `gameStateManager.h` / `gameStateManager.cpp` | **Singleton** that owns the whole simulation: party, city/dungeon location, play‑time, save/load, game‑value map, monster/spell/item data arrays, Lua state, network socket, autosave, etc. |
| `blacklands.h` | Declares `GameMenu` (root widget) and `GameController` (main loop). |
| `blacklands.cpp` | `main()` and `GameController` implementation (game loop). |

### Character & Party

| File / Symbol | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| `character.h` / `character.cpp` | **Struct `Character`** with runtime fields (name, race, level, stats, HP/MP, inventory, equipment, guild levels, skill system, etc.) and serialization (`toMap()` / `loadFromMap()`). Also defines **struct `Party`** (list of `Character`s + shared gold) and `HeldItem`. |
| `partymanager/PartyManager.h` / `PartyManager.cpp` | Owns a `Party` instance, adds experience, applies level‑up gains, persists party, provides a `QVariantMap` view for UI. |
| `character_dialog/CharacterDialog.h` / `CharacterDialog.cpp` | UI for creating/editing characters (race, alignment, stats, etc.). |
| `character_dialog/CharacterSheetDialog.h` / `CharacterSheetDialog.cpp` | The character sheet: displays stats, equipment, spells, **skill allocation** (skill table, points label, learn‑button), guilds, etc. |

### Items & Inventory

| File / Symbol | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| `items/ItemDatabase.h` / `ItemDatabase.cpp` | Typed view of the item definitions (loaded from `MDATA3`). Provides `byId()`, `byName()`, `all()`, etc. |
| `items/ItemProgression.h` / `ItemProgression.cpp` | Handles item identification, progression, and market values. |
| `items/HeldItem` | In‑game item record (ID, name, charges, identified flag). Used in character inventory. |
| `inventory_dialog/inventorydialog.h` / `inventorydialog.cpp` | UI for managing a character's inventory and equipment. |

### Spells & Magic

| File / Symbol | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| `spell_casting/SpellBook.h` / `SpellBook.cpp` | Operations on spells: load from data, compute MP cost, handle school proficiency, etc. |
| `spell_casting/SpellMechanics.h` / `SpellMechanics.cpp` | Core spell logic: damage, healing, save checks, etc. |
| `spell_casting/SpellCastingDialog.h` / `SpellCastingDialog.cpp` | UI for casting spells, shows MP cost, school, etc. |

### Combat & Dungeon

| File / Symbol | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| `combat/CombatState.h` / `CombatState.cpp` | Holds current combat state: participants, turn order, active effects, etc. |
| `combat/TurnEngine.h` / `TurnEngine.cpp` | Drives turns, initiative, and action resolution. |
| `combat/CombatActions.h` / `CombatActions.cpp` | Abstracts combat actions (attack, spell, skill‑based actions). |
| `combat/MonsterAI.h` / `MonsterAI.cpp` | AI for monsters: chooses actions based on threat, target, status effects. |
| `combat/EncounterBuilder.h` / `EncounterBuilder.cpp` | Creates dungeon encounters, suitable for level. |
| `combat/VictoryReward.h` / `VictoryReward.cpp` | Calculates XP, gold, loot based on party size and boss. |
| `combat/CombatDeathHandler.h` / `CombatDeathHandler.cpp` | Handles death, resurrection, and party wipe logic. |
| `dungeon_dialog/DungeonDialog.h` / `DungeonDialog.cpp` | Main dungeon UI: minimap, party status, action buttons. |
| `dungeon_dialog/DungeonHandlers.h` / `DungeonHandlers.cpp` | Handles player input in the dungeon (movement, interact, pick‑up, etc.). |
| `dungeon_dialog/DungeonMinimap.h` / `DungeonMinimap.cpp` | Shows an auto‑updating minimap. |

### UI & Dialogs

| File / Symbol | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| `character_dialog/CreateCharacterDialog.h` / `.cpp` | Walk‑through for creating a new character. |
| `character_dialog/CharacterSheetDialog.h` / `.cpp` | **Character sheet UI**, now includes skill allocation table and points label (v6.1.0 slice 6.1a). |
| `library_dialog/BestiaryDialog.h` / `.cpp` | Displays monster journal. |

| `victory_dialog/VictoryDialog.h` / `.cpp` | Victory / combat results UI. |
| `helplesson/helplesson.h` / `.cpp` | “Helpless heart” tutorial. |
| `options_dialog/optionsdialog.h` | Options menu. |
| `storyDialog.h` | Story / intro dialog. |

### Game Logic & Progression

| File / Symbol | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| `core/GameConstants.h` | Enum `EntityStatuses`, `GameMode`, `CityLocation`, `RaceStats`, guild lists, `SKILL_POINTS_PER_LEVEL`, etc. |
| `core/LevelTable.h` / `LevelTable.cpp` | Loads `levels.json` and provides `levelForXp()`, `xpForLevel()` methods. |
| `core/QuestChain.h` / `QuestChainDriver.h` / `QuestChainDriver.cpp` | Quest chain system: definitions, progression, rewards. |
| `core/Endgame.h` / `Endgame.cpp` | Endgame progression, NG+, etc. |
| `core/Arena.h` / `Arena.cpp` | Arena mode logic. |
| `core/AchievementSystem.h` / `AchievementSystem.cpp` | Achievement tracking. |
| `core/AgingRules.h` / `AgingRules.cpp` | Aging rules, age caps, consequences. |
| `core/DeathRecovery.h` / `DeathRecovery.cpp` | Dungeon recovery. |
| `core/AlignmentSystem.h` / `AlignmentSystem.cpp` | Alignment checks. |
| `core/SoundEffects.h` / `SoundEffects.cpp` | Sound management. |
| `core/ReleaseInfo.h` / `ReleaseInfo.cpp` | Version metadata and release notes. |
| `core/SoundEffects.h`/`.cpp` | Sound sampling. |
| `event/EventManager.h` / `EventManager.cpp` | Random world events. |
| `network_manager/NetworkManager.h` / `.cpp` | TCP networking for multiplayer city. |
| `update/UpdateManager.h` / `.cpp`, `UpdateDialog.h` / `.cpp` | Auto‑update dialog. |

### Networking & Updates

| File / Symbol | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| `network_manager/NetworkManager.h` / `.cpp` | TCP client/server, chat, sync. |
| `update/UpdateManager.h` / `.cpp`, `UpdateDialog.h` / `.cpp` | Update checking. |

### Skill System (v6.1.0 slice 6.1a)

| File / Symbol | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| `src/skill/SkillDef.h` | **Struct `SkillDef`** – defines a skill: `name`, `description`, `cost` (skill points required for a level), `prerequisite` (skill name or `""`), `type`, `icon`. |
| `src/skill/SkillDatabase.h` | Declares `QVector<SkillDef> skillDefs();` – returns the static skill list. |
| `src/skill/SkillDatabase.cpp` | Implements `skillDefs()`; currently defines a small set: Swordsmanship, Archery, Stealth, Alchemy, Smithing, Persuasion, First Aid, plus **Advanced Swordsmanship** (pre‑req: Swordsmanship, cost = 2). |
| `character.h` (edits) | Added `m_skillPoints` (unspent skill point pool) and `skillLevels` map (skill name → level). Methods: `addSkillPoints(int)`, `skillPoints() const`, `skillLevel(const QString&) const`, `learnSkill(const QString&, int&, QString&)`. |
| `character.cpp` (edits) | Implementations of the skill methods; `learnSkill()` checks prerequisite, cost, and updates `skillLevels`. |
| `CharacterSheetDialog.h` / `.cpp` | Added UI group box for skill allocation: table (skill, level, prerequisite, cost), label showing remaining skill points, “Learn Selected Skill” button, and `onLearnSkill()` slot. `refreshSheet()` now populates skill table from `skillDefs()`. |

---

## Build System & Dependencies

### `blacklands.pro` (qmake)

* Target binary: `blacklands`
* Configured with **C++20** and **Qt 6** (`core`, `gui`, `widgets`, `multimedia`, `network`).
* **SOURCES** list:
  * All core source files (`gameStateManager.cpp`, `character.cpp`, `PartyManager.cpp`, etc.)
  * UI dialogs (`CharacterSheetDialog.cpp`, etc.)
  * `test/selftest.cpp`, `test/equipment_test.cpp`
  * All `src/*/*.cpp` files (complete list in project file)
* **HEADERS** list mirrors the sources, plus header‑only dependencies.
* **3rd‑party**: bundled Lua 5.5 sources are compiled statically (`3rdparty/lua/*.c`).
* **Versioning**: `blacklands.pro` extracts the current git commit hash, date, and a `VERSION_INT` from the commit count; it then generates `version.h` from `version.h.in`.
* Posts‑link steps copy the `data/` and `resources/` folders into the build directory and copy the final binary to the repo root.
* Defines a custom **check** target: `make check` runs `blacklands --selftest` and `tools/check_orphaned_systems.py`.

### Generated Files

* `version.h` – filled from `version.h.in` with `VERSION_HASH`, `VERSION_DATE`, `VERSION_INT`.
* `Makefile` – generated by qmake.
* Object files and binary placed in `build/`.

### Dependencies

* **Qt 6** (Core, GUI, Widgets, Multimedia, Network)
* **Lua 5.5** (bundled under `3rdparty/lua`)
* **C++20** capable compiler

## Data & Assets

| Category | Examples |
|----------|----------|
| **JSON** | `levels.json`, `guilds.json`, `spells.json`, `races.json`, `bestiary.json`, `monster_research_data.json` |
| **CSV** | `MDATA3.csv` (items), `MDATA11_Lairs_Teleporters.csv`, etc. (various raw data dumps) |
| **Binary loaders** | `MDATA*.MDR`, `MDATA*.hex`, `MDATA*.txt` – pre‑processed datasets for items, monsters, guilds, etc. |
| **Lua** | `data/scripts/*.lua` – game logic scripts; `data/MonsterData.lua` – monster research data. |
| **Characters** | `data/characters/*.json` – example saved characters (used for demo/pack). |
| **Saves** | `data/saves/*.json` – quick‑save examples. |
| **Resources** | `resources/images`, `resources/midi`, `resources/mp3`, `resources/waves` – artwork, audio, fonts. |
| **Version & Build** | `version.h.in` (template), `version.h` (generated), `blacklands.pro` (build). |

## Testing

| File / Symbol | Description |
|---------------|-------------|
| `test/selftest.cpp` | Headless test harness. `runSelfTest()` runs a battery of unit tests (game constants, level table, combat, etc.). Entry point for `blacklands --selftest`. |
| `test/selftest.h` | Declares `runSelfTest()`; used by the binary and by test utilities. |
| `test/equipment_test.cpp` | Tests item‑related behaviour (equip/unequip, identification, cursed items, guild restrictions, etc.). |
| `test/test_updater.cpp` / `.h` | Additional tests for the update manager. |

All tests are compiled into the main binary and run via `make check`.

## Tools & Utilities

The `tools/` directory contains utilities for data conversion, map/room editing, and various helpers:

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `tools/complication_calculator` | Calculates complications for character generation. |
| `tools/complication_effect` | Applies complication effects. |
| `tools/imagesplitter` | Splits sprite sheets. |
| `tools/dungeonconverter` | Converts dungeon map formats. |
| `tools/editors/` | Various editor UIs (monster, spell, map). |
| `tools/gamedataconverter` | Converts game data files. |
| `tools/generalstoreconverter` | Converts general store data. |
| `tools/itemconverter` | Converts item definitions. |
| `tools/map_editor` | Map editor. |
| `tools/monsterconverter` | Converts monster definitions. |
| `tools/monster_editor` | Monster editor UI. |
| `tools/spellbook_editor` | Spellbook editor. |
| `tools/spellconverter` | Spell data converter. |
| `tools/characterconverter` | Converts character data. |
| `tools/complication_effect` | Handles complication effects. |
| `tools/cssviewer` | CSS viewer for UI inspection. |
| `tools/check_orphaned_systems.py` | Checks for unused systems in tests. |
| `data/decode.sh` | Decode raw data files. |
| `data/MLoader.cpp` / `.h` | Loads and parses the compiled data files. |
| `data/RecordReader.h` | Reads record‑based binary data. |
| `data/data_loader.pro` | qmake file for the data conversion tools. |

## Recent Additions (v6.1.0 slice 6.1a – Skill Acquisition & Allocation)

* New header `src/skill/SkillDef.h` defines the `SkillDef` struct.
* New header `src/skill/SkillDatabase.h` and source `src/skill/SkillDatabase.cpp` provide the static skill list.
* `character.h` / `character.cpp` now support **skill point allocation**:
  * `m_skillPoints` – unspent skill points
  * `skillLevels` – map of skill name → level
  * `addSkillPoints(int)`, `skillPoints() const`, `skillLevel(const QString&) const`, `learnSkill(const QString&, int&, QString&)`
* `CharacterSheetDialog` now displays a **skill allocation UI**:
  * Table with skill, level, prerequisite, cost
  * Label showing remaining skill points
  * “Learn Selected Skill” button wiring to `onLearnSkill()`
* `GameConstants.h` defines `SKILL_POINTS_PER_LEVEL = 3`.

Backend now **compiles** (qmake + make), and the skill system is ready for UI‑driven allocation and testing (tests to be added in subsequent slices).
